itens.titulo: Coca-Cola’s 64-Year Dividend Growth Streak Faces a Valuation Reality Check
itens.descricao: Coca-Cola’s 64-Year Dividend Growth Streak Faces a Valuation Reality Check Yahoo Finance
trechos: The company's second-quarter 2026 results show why investors keep coming back.
Revenue climbed 7% from the year before, hitting $13.4 billion, and organic revenue wasn't far behind with a 6% gain.
Operating margin ticked up to 34.9%.
Earnings per share rose 16% to $1.03, partly thanks to favorable currency moves.
What's especially encouraging is that unit case volume went up 5%, so growth didn't just rely on price hikes.

Also read: 10 Best Bear Market Stocks to Invest In Right Now Dividend Growth Is Stronger Than the Starting Yield Earlier this year, The Coca-Cola Company (NYSE:KO) increased its quarterly dividend by about 4%, moving from $0.51 to $0.53 per share.
That puts the annual payout at $2.12, extending an impressive 64-year streak of dividend hikes.
The forward yield sits at roughly 2.4%.

itens.titulo: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang addresses CoreWeave stock plunge: 'I'm optimistic'
itens.descricao: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang addresses CoreWeave stock plunge: 'I'm optimistic' Yahoo Finance UK
trechos: Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang addressed the recent discord at key partner and fallen AI stock darling CoreWeave (CRWV) on Thursday, expressing optimism in the data center operator following a 15% rout on Wednesday and a smaller dip on Thursday morning.
"CoreWeave's strength is improving every day," Huang shared at a Bloomberg event in Stockholm.
Their cost of capital is actually decreasing." His input was much anticipated this week as concerns about the health of CoreWeave and its exposures to Nvidia have continued to build.
Huang's need to weigh in wasn't a surprise to veteran tech analyst Tal Liani, who just this morning published a bullish note on CoreWeave with an aggressive $140 price target.
"Don't forget that Nvidia is basically financing all these deals with them, with other hyperscalers because they want to block off the competition.
They want to make sure that CoreWeave and others are using Nvidia GPUs and not AMD GPUs," Liani said on Sozzi Unleashed.
Liani added, "So at the end of the day, there is an inherent interest both ways.
It's just a question of time." CoreWeave's corporate bonds across maturities have continued to be dumped amid fears of an AI slowdown and its implications for the company's precarious balance sheet.

itens.titulo: Chevron Corporation (CVX) Hits Fresh High: Is There Still Room to Run?
itens.descricao: Chevron Corporation (CVX) Hits Fresh High: Is There Still Room to Run? Yahoo Finance
trechos: Shares have been marching higher, with the stock up 5% over the past month.
The stock hit a new 52-week high of $222.55 in the previous session.
Chevron has gained 45.7% since the start of the year compared to the 40.4% gain for the Zacks Oils-Energy sector and the 47.9% return for the Zacks Oil and Gas - Integrated - International industry.
In its last earnings report on July 31, 2026, Chevron reported EPS of $6.06 versus consensus estimate of $5.8.
For the current fiscal year, Chevron is expected to post earnings of $17.53 per share on $239.3 in revenues.
This represents a 140.47% change in EPS on a 26.59% change in revenues.
For the next fiscal year, the company is expected to earn $15.5 per share on $236.24 in revenues.
This represents a year-over-year change of -11.6% and -1.28%, respectively.
